name: Non AI Agent Migration to Chat 2.0
author: Ava
description: Prototype of new chat UI preview in legacy settings, enabling Chat 2.0 as a non-AI agent customer, and the ability to temporarily revery back

name: Ads to Convo
author: Ava
description: Brand-switchable demo of ads-to-conversation flows: Instagram ad → PDP / half-sheet / direct chat with multi-turn AI dialogue, recommendation card, and a per-brand live edit panel.

name: Sachin & Babi · Ads to Messaging
author: Ava
description: Sachin & Babi build of the ads-to-messaging prototype: Instagram ad → PDP / Half-sheet / Direct to chat flows with multi-turn AI dialogue. Features the Laurant Gown with selectable colourways (swatches swap the dress image) and sizes, plus SPQs and chat answers tuned to Sachin & Babi's real top FAQs and elegant brand voice.

name: One Bone · Ads to Messaging
author: Ava
description: One Bone build of the ads-to-messaging prototype, featuring the Bullet Tee. PDP with colour swatches (swap the image) and One Bone's numeric sizing. The Halfsheet flow is replaced with a glassy bottom 'Chat to shop' dock — SPQ pills + Reviews, an in-hood mini conversation (typing → answer → follow-up chips → product rec), minimize, and expand-to-full-chat carrying the transcript over. SPQs and answers tuned to One Bone's real tickets (sizing, fit, size guide, restock, promos).

name: OSEA · Ads to Messaging
author: Ava
description: OSEA build of the ads-to-messaging prototype, featuring the Hyaluronic Sea Serum. Instagram ad → PDP and Direct-to-chat flows (no half-sheet) with multi-turn AI dialogue. PDP shows the serum gallery, $88, and a 1 fl oz size. SPQs and chat answers are tuned to OSEA's clean, coastal voice — how to use, benefits, skin type, ingredients (two HA weights + Japanese seaweed), layering, results, and a first-order offer.

name: Sleeplay · Ads to Messaging
author: Ava
description: Sleeplay build of the ads-to-messaging prototype, featuring the ResMed AirFit P10 nasal pillow CPAP mask. Instagram ad → PDP and Direct-to-chat flows (no half-sheet). PDP shows the mask gallery, $105, and nasal-pillow size options (Fit Pack / XS / S / M / L). SPQs and chat answers reflect Sleeplay's real customer tickets — choosing the right items, prescription requirements & order flow, what's included, machine compatibility, setup, compliance reports & myAir/AirView data sharing, filter & part replacement, HSA/FSA, and refurbished/discontinued availability.

name: Jax Athletix · Ads to Messaging
author: Ava
description: Jax Athletix build of the ads-to-messaging prototype, featuring the Big League Berry Strap Cuff batting glove. Instagram ad → PDP and Ad-to-Convo (Direct to chat) flows. PDP has color swatches across the Strap Cuff colorways (swap the image), a With Web / No Web + swing-hand selector, and sizes YS–XXL. The chat is FAQ-driven with branching follow-ups in Jax's product-advisory voice — web technology (D3O), sizing, hand orientation, youth fit, materials, care, and availability.

name: Farmacy · Cart Recovery Chat
author: Ava
description: Mobile prototype of a post-SMS cart-recovery chat on Farmacy's Honey Skincare collection. Tapping the floating chat icon opens a full-page Farmacy skincare-expert chat with Claude-style SPQs stacked above the input. Tapping the product card opens a Honey Halo PDP with subscribe/one-time, SPQs, and Add-to-cart. Live edit panel for chat copy, SPQs, and a regex-keyed response library — all persisted to localStorage.

name: SPQs — Shopping Assistant (3 flows)
author: Ava
description: Suggested Prompted Questions on a Hotel Lobby Candle storefront with a topbar flow switcher: ASAP (floating SPQ pills above the chat launcher), Medium term (centered bottom 'Chat to shop' bar that slides right to open the chat), and Longer term (no floating SPQs — header search opens an AI-suggestions overlay). Shared chat: SPQ → answer → scent quick-replies (warm/fresh/moody) → 3 matching products → PDP bottom drawer + Add to Cart. SPQs appear on Home and all collection pages. Includes the Gorgias admin (Axiom) Shopping Assistant page with the SPQ configuration drawer.

name: AI Assistant Settings — Shopping Assistant
author: Ava
description: Gorgias admin (Axiom) Shopping Assistant settings page. Pick a selling-style archetype (Educational / Guided / Bold) and a live chat preview swaps to a matching sample transcript. Includes a Discount strategy sub-tab (No discount / On abandonment / Strategic / Generous + fixed-discount input and Shopify auto-discounts note) and a Contextual rules sub-tab with togglable behavior rules. Hand-rewritten from a Lovable React export into a single self-contained HTML file.

name: Violette_Web · Medium term shopping assistant
author: Ava
description: VIOLETTE_FR desktop Home + Skincare collection pages with the Medium term shopping-assistant chat dock: a centered glassy 'Chat to shop' hood with horizontal SPQ pills, an in-hood mini conversation (typing → answer → follow-up chips → product carousel), Reviews chip with collapsible category summaries, minimize, and expand to a full Violette chat panel that carries the transcript over. Real product data — Boum-Boum Milk, C'est La Cream, Invisible Bandage, and the Sérum Superlatif quartet — plus Plume Blush + Le Kabuki on Home. Mobile dock is edge-to-edge and safe-area aware.

name: Shopping Assistant typing animations
author: Ava
description: Showcase of typing / loading indicators for the Estaluna shopping-assistant chat. Six variants shown in identical chat shells: four human-typing styles (bouncing dots, fading dots in a glass bubble with a sweeping glow, ripple dots, and a single sweeping dot) and two AI-loading styles (a spinning sparkle star with wave bars, and breathing bars). Hand-rewritten from a Lovable React export into a single self-contained HTML file.

name: Melinda Maria × Kosas — Chat Prototype
author: Ava
description: Two-flow, brand-switchable Gorgias chat concierge prototype. Flow 1 recreates the Melinda Maria homepage with a grey-glass chat launcher and panel matching the live site's design (custom wordmark lockup, glass buttons, monitored/recorded disclaimer). Flow 2 recreates the Kosas homepage with a left-docked launcher, a warm cream/yellow panel theme, quick-reply pills, and a clickable privacy-policy disclaimer. A floating top switcher toggles between the two.
